en_title: Jeremy Clarkson Will Return to His Automotive Roots for One-Off Special ‘Jeremy Grows a Car’
cn_title: 克拉克森将用农场产物造车
subtitle: 从种地到造车
opus_summary: Prime Video确认《克拉克森的农场》将推出汽车特别篇，于2027年播出。克拉克森将尝试用自家农场的产物修复并打造汽车，汽车设计师Ian Callum将协助。

paragraphs.en: Prime Video has confirmed a new, one-off episode of its Clarkson’s Farm series, which will see host Jeremy Clarkson temporarily return to his Top Gear and The Grand Tour roots for an automotive-themed special.
paragraphs.cn: Prime Video确认，《克拉克森的农场》将推出一集汽车主题特别篇。主持人杰里米·克拉克森将暂时回归老本行，重拾他在《Top Gear》和《The Grand Tour》中主持汽车节目的经历。

paragraphs.en: Jeremy Grows a Car: A Clarkson’s Farm Special will see Clarkson attempt what Prime proposes is a world first: he will grow and build his own car from produce sourced from his personal farm, Diddly Squat.
paragraphs.cn: 在《Jeremy Grows a Car：克拉克森的农场特别篇》中，克拉克森将尝试用自家Diddly Squat农场出产的农产品，「种」出并打造一辆属于自己的汽车。Prime称，这将是世界首创。

paragraphs.en: Using the Jaguar F-Type V6S as his base, Clarkson will be restoring it using his own Diddly leather interior and wool carpets, and will also be attempting to grow a crop of flax fiber to turn into a sustainable flax-composite material – an alternative to carbon fiber Prime claims is already on the radar of major car makers.
paragraphs.cn: 克拉克森将以捷豹F-Type V6S为基础，用自家Diddly农场出产的皮革制作内饰，用羊毛制作地毯，来修复这辆车。他还将尝试种植亚麻，获取纤维并将其制成可持续的亚麻复合材料，用来替代碳纤维。Prime称，各大汽车制造商已经开始关注这种材料。

paragraphs.en: Clarkson will be aided in his car-building quest by legendary car designer Ian Callum CBE. Callum is the designer of the original Jaguar F-Type, as well as the Jaguar XK and C-X75, plus the Aston Martin Vanquish, DB7, and DB9. He was also involved with the Ford RS200 and the Nissan R390.
paragraphs.cn: 传奇汽车设计师、大英帝国司令勋章获得者Ian Callum将协助克拉克森完成造车计划。Callum设计了初代捷豹F-Type，以及捷豹XK、C-X75和阿斯顿·马丁Vanquish、DB7、DB9。他还参与了福特RS200和日产R390的设计。

paragraphs.en: Jeremy Grows a Car: A Clarkson’s Farm Special will air in 2027.
paragraphs.cn: 《Jeremy Grows a Car: A Clarkson’s Farm Special》将于2027年播出。
